crossRefs.note: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.
For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a…

translations.web: You returned and wept before Yahweh; but Yahweh didn’t listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you.
translations.bsb: And you returned and wept before the LORD, but He would not listen to your voice or give ear to you.
translations.kjv: And ye returned and wept before the LORD; but the LORD would not hearken to your voice, nor give ear
translations.asv: And ye returned and wept before Jehovah; but Jehovah hearkened not to your voice, nor gave ear unto you.
